hairpin.rationale: A pre-run geometry sweep showed that 2-10 m ramps require 23.71-15.12 deg on at least one offset vehicle. An 11 m ramp gives a predicted four-vehicle maximum target angle of 14.88 deg, below the frozen 15 deg limit with a small discrete margin.
required_disclosures: actual maximum deviation from the unsmoothed semicircle
entry, middle and exit phase metrics

hairpin_low_level_tracker_repair_1.yaw_feasibility: Scale one shared desired yaw rate toward zero by bisection until all four target steering angles are within 15 deg; do not clip wheels independently.
hairpin_low_level_tracker_repair_1.status: frozen before the first repaired full P0/2ms trajectory

hairpin_low_level_tracker_repair_2.rationale: Repair 1 failed because yaw feedback drove the reference beta state outside the 15 deg feasible set. This final minimal ablation isolates common speed loss while retaining the prevalidated route yaw feedforward.
